facts.text: `TernInlineSurface` in `.pi/lib/tern/tsp.ts` tags frames with `#seq`, raises `#acked` on ack events, and skips flushing while `#seq - #acked >= #credits` unless forced. `render` overwrites `#pending`, so only the newest view is kept. Frames are diffed against `#sent` (last sent view), not the last acknowledged view as the L236-237 comment says.
Session scope for `memory_history` is an in-memory `MemoryHistory` loaded from Pi session custom entries of type `pi-swarm-memory` (`MEMORY_ENTRY_TYPE`). `correct` and `get` reject session scope.

Repository, worktree and global scopes use `openKnowledgeStore` (`KnowledgeStore`). `remember` and `correct` call `put`, `delete` calls `KnowledgeStore.delete` (tombstone), and `put` defaults status to `candidate`.
Verified knowledge requires evidence: `validateEvent` and `KnowledgeStore.put` throw `Verified knowledge requires evidence` when a verified record has no evidence.

Agent `memory_history` cannot write global or all scope (`remember` throws for them). Global promotion goes through the `/memory-promote` command, and `KnowledgeStore` global mutation requires `allowGlobal`.

`memory_history` `offer` routes to `handoffMemory` and only accepts repository or worktree scope. `search` also returns legacy shared-memory records marked status unverified. `migrate` converts session entries via `history.migrate`.
`memory_history` `recall` and `ask` reject session scope and call the lookup path with `answerRequired` set for `ask`.
The memory store root is `PI_SWARM_MEMORY_DIR` when set, otherwise `~/.swarm/memory` (`sharedMemoryRoot`).
Knowledge stores live at `<root>/knowledge/<scope>/<key>`. The key is `shared` for global and the first 32 hex chars of a sha256 of the git identity (`digest`) otherwise.
`memoryIdentity` uses `git rev-parse --git-common-dir` for repository and `--show-toplevel` for worktree, falling back to cwd for both when git fails.
Legacy flat files at `<root>/<scope>/<hash>/<uuid>.json` are read by `searchShared`. `rememberShared` still writes that layout, and its only callers under `.pi` are tests.
TaskManage state commits as `pi-swarm-task-state` session entries. Each is a full snapshot with `schemaVersion` 2, `revision` and `savedAt`, written in `commit`.
`replayLatest` skips entries with a schema version newer than current or that fail migration, and selects the highest-revision valid snapshot.
TaskManage operation audit events use `pi-swarm-task-operation` (type at `task-manage.ts` L78, emitted at L844). Task hook state is stored separately as `pi-swarm-task-hooks` entries.
The TaskManage source imports no file-write API (`node:fs` gives only existsSync, readFileSync, statSync and realpathSync), so tasks are not stored on disk.
Question lists must have 1 to `MAX_TASK_QUESTIONS` (12) items with unique ids. Question id is at most 64 and text at most 240 characters (`validateQuestions`, `validQuestion`).
Each answer needs non-empty `question`, `answer` (max 2000) and `evidence` (max 512) fields, no extra fields, and no duplicate question ids (`validateAnswers`).
Saved answers are kept only while their question still exists with identical text (`retainedAnswers`).
`tool:<Name>[#n]` evidence resolves only against tool-result messages on the current session branch (`sessionResultNames` with `getBranch`, used by `resolveToolEvidence`).
`task-hooks.ts` `READ_TOOLS` includes `historysearch` and `historyget`, and `exempt()` exempts them. `memory_history` appears in none of the exempt sets there.

In block mode with no focused task, `TaskEnforcementHook.onToolBefore` blocks tools that are not exempt. Exemptions are task, plan, skill, user-interaction, CodeMode and read-only exploration tools, read-only Bash, and `memory_history` only for search or get (`isReadOnlyMemoryCall`). Read-only recall tools such as `historysearch` are not exempt here.
